Are you a contracts expert who wants to work on the largest defence project in WA?   Your new company     Hays is currently recruiting a Senior Commercial Advisor for the Australian Submarine Company who has been selected to deliver a $12B defence project in Henderson, WA.    If you have 6+ years experience in Commercial Advisory on heavy engineering or defence projects, this could be for you.   Please note that this role requires a security clearance. Security clearances can only be granted to Australian citizens. For more information, please visit: https://www.agsva.gov.au/   Your new role     The Senior Commercial Advisor will support the Commercial team in providing contract and commercial advice, guidance and capability to the Nuclear Submarine Sustainment Programme, the largest and most complex industrial undertaking in Australia's history.    
 
 Provide contractual and commercial advice and guidance    
 Prepare commercial related documents for submission to the client   
 Support the programme to navigate complex contract management    
 Draft and negotiate contracts with head contractors for licencing, leasing and training    
 Develop and manage contract change proposals

result.description: AGROVISE  Due to continued business growth, we are seeking a motivated and experienced Agricultural and Agritech Technician to join our team. The successful applicant will support the installation, commissioning, operation, testing, maintenance and optimisation of agricultural technology systems and equipment, while assisting with irrigation management, precision agriculture, crop production technologies, field trials, technical data collection and the delivery of innovative agritech solutions across a range of agricultural projects in Western Australia.   Benefits   Competitive salary package of $80,000 – $100,000 plus superannuation.   Ongoing training and professional development in agricultural technology, irrigation and automation systems.   Opportunity to work with innovative agricultural, water and renewable energy projects across Western Australia.    Task & responsibilities   Examine topographical, physical and soil characteristics of farmland to assist in determining optimal land use and identifying nutrient deficiencies.   Assist Agricultural Research Scientists and Agronomists in developing improved methods of planting, fertilising, irrigation, harvesting and crop management to maximise productivity.   Identify plant diseases, pests, fungi and weeds affecting agricultural production and assist in implementing appropriate control measures.   Provide technical advice, training and support to clients on agricultural technology solutions, including sensors, remote monitoring systems, farm management software and automation technologies.   Install, configure, program, test, commission, repair and maintain advanced agricultural technology and equipment, including irrigation controllers, pumping systems, sensors, telemetry, automation and precision agriculture systems.   Develop, operate and maintain integrated agricultural technology systems used in irrigation, water management and farm production, including analysing operational data and preparing technical reports.   Conduct field testing, equipment inspections, fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance to ensure efficient operation of agricultural infrastructure and agritech equipment.   Collect, record and analyse technical and operational data to evaluate system performance and recommend improvements.   Prepare technical documentation, maintenance records, installation reports and service schedules.   Work collaboratively with engineers, project managers and clients to deliver innovative agricultural infrastructure and technology solutions while ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety requirements.    Qualification & experience   Certificate IV, Diploma or higher qualification in Agricultural Technology, Agricultural Engineering,  or a closely related discipline.   At least one year of relevant industry experience (more experienced applicants are encouraged to apply).   Experience working with irrigation systems, pumps, agricultural equipment or automated control systems.    About Company    Agrovise is a Western Australian engineering and agritech company specialising in greenhouse infrastructure, protected cropping and agricultural technology solutions. The company designs, installs and maintains greenhouse systems, irrigation and fertigation infrastructure, climate control and automation systems, helping commercial growers improve productivity, water efficiency and sustainable farming practices across Western Australia.
